verdict.rationale: Stable's own docs state the API 'currently' supports only a narrow slice — searching/retrieving MailItems, creating/onboarding Locations, Companies, and Checks — while the UI/product pages advertise many more capabilities (scan, ship, deposit, shred, AI summaries, tagging, custom roles, Slack/email notifications, mail routing) with no documented API endpoints for most of these; webhook and API-key management are also dashboard-only per docs. No OpenAPI spec is discoverable (404s), reinforcing that API surface is limited. missing for 10: API endpoints for scan/ship/deposit/shred actions, AI summary retrieval via API, tagging/roles/permissions via API, webhook/API-key CRUD via API, and any independent confirmation of API completeness.
